title: Scope of Work
subtitle: Plain-language summary of the work. Pricing happens behind the scenes.

empty.title: No scope yet
empty.body: Start a walkthrough and describe the job out loud. We'll write the scope for you.

pendingChanges: The scope changed since you approved it.

actions.advancedHint: Build detailed scope sections, line items, and templates.

editor.title: Edit wording
editor.hint: Write it the way you'd say it to the customer. Regenerating replaces your edits.

questions.title: A few questions
questions.hint: Answer only what's missing. Skip anything you're not sure about.
questions.none: The scope has enough information to proceed — nothing else to ask.
questions.reviewHint: Everything is answered. Change anything that no longer matches the job.

prompt.decision: What did the customer decide about {{subject}}?
prompt.garage_door_disposition: Are the existing garage doors staying, being removed and framed in, or replaced with a window?
prompt.bath_fixture_type: Is the new bathroom a shower only, or a tub and shower?
prompt.hvac_strategy: Are you extending the existing heating system into the new space, or adding a separate unit?
prompt.opening_disposition: Are the existing windows being reused, replaced, or relocated?
prompt.structural_wall: Is this a load-bearing wall? If so, a structural beam/header will need to be included.
prompt.electrical_service: Will the new circuits run off the existing panel, a new subpanel, or a service upgrade?
prompt.interior_door_style: Should the new bedroom entry door match the existing interior doors?
prompt.bath_exhaust_venting: Is the bathroom exhaust fan venting through the wall or the roof?
prompt.flooring_selection: What flooring do you want in the finished space?
prompt.finish_level: What finish level should we price — builder, standard, or premium?

proposal.title: Proposal Scope of Work
proposal.subtitle: Exactly what the customer sees. No estimating terminology.
proposal.notApproved: Approve the scope to generate the proposal.

toast.validationBlocked: Resolve the flagged scope items before approving.

capturedDescription.title: Captured Project Description
capturedDescription.hint: Exactly as captured by the contractor.

review.title: Review scope changes
review.subtitle: Your wording changed the work. Confirm what should change in the scope — nothing is applied until you do.
review.removedNote: Confirmed removals are excluded from the estimate and kept in history. Nothing is deleted.
